_readme: Did You Know? facts for the Clash of Clans pages. th18-layouts.html loads this file, shuffles it on every visit and cycles through the facts under the hero. Each fact was checked against the sources listed with it on the date in `verified`. Game numbers change with balance updates -- re-check a fact's sources after a big update. `text` is shown as-is and the page cuts it at 2 lines with an ellipsis, so each one must fill TWO lines -- roughly 95 to 106 characters. Shorter leaves a near-empty second line on desktop; longer spills past two lines where the box is narrowest (laptops around 1400px wide) and ends in an ellipsis. Phones under 500px allow three lines. `type` is informational only (mechanic / war / slang / esports / tactic / trivia). Facts added later carry their own `verified` date, which overrides the file-level one.

facts.text: The Eagle Artillery sleeps until enough housing space is deployed. Clan Castle troops don't count.
The Eagle Artillery has a 7-tile blind spot. Troops right next to it can't be hit and can take it down.
The Revenge Tower sleeps until 5 buildings fall, then speeds up and chains as more go down.
At TH18, two Wizard Towers merge into a Super Wizard Tower whose lightning chains to 15 enemies.
Clans at level 7+ can donate one extra spell, so with every perk your Clan Castle holds up to 4 spells.
Temporary event troops and spells can't be used in Clan Wars, Clan War League or Ranked Battles.
The Totem Spell stuns the buildings it lands on, then stays behind to pull defense fire off your troops.
Single-target Infernos ramp up the longer they stay locked on. Multi-target mode never ramps up.
The Poison Spell does no damage to buildings. It only hurts and slows defending troops and heroes.
A destroyed Siege Machine releases the Clan Castle troops inside. You can also release them early.
Enemy Clan Castle troops wait inside until you come within 12 tiles, then chase your troops anywhere.
Hidden Teslas stay invisible until a troop gets within 6 tiles, then pop up and zap anything within 7.
An X-Bow set to Ground only reaches 14 tiles. Switching it to Air & Ground cuts its range to 11.
The Air Sweeper deals zero damage. It only pushes air troops back, and only in the one direction it faces.
Seeking Air Mines ignore air troops under 5 housing space, so Minions and Bats fly right past.
The Monolith deals bonus damage based on its target's HP. The tankier the troop, the harder it hits.
Stars come from 50% destruction, the Town Hall, and 100%. A 99% attack can never be a 3-star.
Every player gets two attacks in a regular Clan War, but can't hit the same base with both of them.
In Clan Wars only your clan's best attack on each base counts, so a weaker repeat adds nothing.
Clan Wars are won on stars. If both clans end on the same stars, higher total destruction % wins.
In Clan War League you get only one attack per war day, over seven war days, so every hit counts.
In Raid Weekend you get 5 attacks, plus a bonus one if your attack fully destroys a district. That's 6 at most.
"Mirror" is the enemy base with the same war number as yours. Most clans want you to hit it first.
"Swag" means troops or spells you never had to use, a sign the attack went better than planned.
"Coco Loons" are single Balloons sent first to set off Seeking Air Mines before your main air army flies in.
"Queen Walk": the Archer Queen and Healers clearing a side. "Queen Charge": taking them into the core.
"Funneling" means clearing both sides of your entry so your army walks into the core, not around it.
"Kiting" means luring enemy Clan Castle troops to a corner with one troop, then killing them safely.
Esports Mode gives defenses and defending heroes +25% damage, and cuts attacking heroes by 20%.
In Esports Mode, Common hero equipment drops 3 levels and Epic drops 6, but never below level 1.
Esports Mode doesn't make Clan Castle troops or traps stronger. The one exception is the Tornado Trap.
Giant Arrow and Seeking Shield keep full damage in Esports Mode, since they deal fixed damage.
Since October 2025, friendly battles can be set to Expert, Master, Legend or Esports difficulty.
Pro wars tied on stars and destruction % go to the faster team: lowest average attack time wins.
Monthly Qualifiers are 128-team double-elimination brackets, played in the in-game Tournament Hub.
Tribe Gaming lost the Worlds final in 2022 and 2024, then finally won the title in 2025, in Atlanta.
QueeN Walkers were Worlds runners-up in 2020 and 2021, then won it in 2022 as QW Stephanie.
Worlds 2025 in Atlanta was the first in-person final outside Europe, after Germany (2019) and Helsinki.
The Warden's Fireball hits the closest defense, so pros make front defenses invisible to aim it at the core.
In Esports Mode, Fireball and Quake Boots need a Spiky Ball or Earthquake to finish a Town Hall.
The Eternal Tome makes troops immune to damage, but slows, Air Sweeper pushes and knockback still work.
Try saving the Eternal Tome for when the Town Hall falls. Its death blast can wipe out your troops.
A Healer locks onto the closest unit and heals only it until it dies. That's how Queen Walks work.
Past two Healers on one unit, each extra one heals less, and no more than 7 can heal the same unit at once.
Overgrown buildings can't be damaged, so a Log Launcher or Wall Wrecker gets stuck on them.
An invisible defense still shoots. Hiding buildings only steers your troops, it doesn't protect them.
Once the Eagle locks on, it fires even if its target turns invisible, so cast Invisibility before it aims.
Four Earthquakes break any Wall and three never will, whatever its level: quakes deal a share of its HP.
Each extra Earthquake on the same building hits weaker: the 2nd does 1/3, the 3rd 1/5, the 4th 1/7.
Earthquake and Lightning can't hurt storages, but Earthquakes still hit the Town Hall and Clan Castle.
Miners counter single-target Infernos. Every time they dig underground, the Inferno's damage resets.
Hog Riders jump over Walls but don't break them. Your other ground troops still need an opening.
Hogs survive one same-level Giant Bomb, not two, even with a Heal. Heal them after the blast, not before.
Hogs and Miners can't hit air, so kill flying Clan Castle troops like Dragons before sending Hybrid in.
A dead Golem splits into 2 Golemites, 3 at level 8 and 4 at level 13. Each has 1/5 of its HP and damage.
Golems are too heavy for Spring Traps, but the smaller Golemites they split into can still be launched away.
Wall Breakers run for the nearest walled-in building, not the Wall, then blow up the Wall in their way.
Wall Breakers ignore single Walls. They need at least 3 connected Walls protecting a building.
A frozen single-target Inferno stops for the whole spell, then restarts from low damage when it thaws.
Wall Breakers hit Walls 40 times harder than normal. Against buildings they do almost nothing.
In 2026, the Barbarian King moved from Town Hall 7 to 4, because players wanted their first Hero sooner.
Since April 2026, Legend League has three tiers: Legend III and II run weekly, Legend I runs 4 weeks.
Legend I resets everyone to 5,000 trophies each tournament. Finish Sunday in the top 10,000 to stay.
